issues.explanation: Migration only edits create_tickets_table to add nullable issue_date with unique(queue_id,code,issue_date); no backfill from DATE(issued_at), no change to NOT NULL, no new migration and no down() for the conversion.

Queue has no saving-time validation/normalization: empty map is not normalized to null on every save and invalid maps do not throw InvalidArgumentException from the model, so direct save/factory can persist invalid maps.
Diff contains no Pest/PHPUnit test files; new prefixes, daily restart, validation, authorization and factory alignment are untested.
IssueTicket calls now() three times for code day, issued_at and issue_date instead of reading the clock once, allowing a midnight split across days.

TicketFactory sets issue_date from now() independently of issued_at and sequences the auto code by that issue_date, so overriding issued_at does not yield that day's N001 nor keep issue_date aligned with issued_at.
priority_prefix_map added to Fillable despite task stating it is not mass-assignable and must change only through UpdateQueue, opening a mass-assignment path around authorization/validation.
UpdateQueue key check uses only ctype_digit, so non-canonical 010 passes though task explicitly lists 010 as invalid and requires canonical integer form.
No updates to docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md or CHANGELOG.md though task requirement 7 demands them.
Ticket::nextCode changed to required (int,int,string) args, breaking existing single-arg callers; optional/defaulted params would preserve compatibility while supporting prefix/day.
nextCode regex uses (\d+) so 1-2 digit codes count as valid, while the task defines codes as one letter plus at least 3 digits.
UpdateQueue has dead is_array check on a ?array parameter, duplicated uniqueness loops, assignment before the uniqueness throw leaving the in-memory model dirty, and broken indentation.

TicketFactory loads a full Queue model and passes $ticket->issue_date (a date-cast Carbon) to a string parameter plus an extra Queue query in nextCode instead of reusing the locked queue/priority/day values.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:10, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:30 and app/Models/Queue.php:124 use Actions correctly, but migration hand-edits create_tickets_table instead of make:migration with down(), docs untouched, no tests, and $fillable deliberately opened against spec (app/Models/Queue.php:96).

readability.evidence: app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:38-80 broken indentation/stray comments/dead is_array; app/Models/Queue.php:105 degraded phpdoc array<string,string|; otherwise names are clear.

requirements.evidence: app/Models/Queue.php:124 prefixForPriority and app/Models/Ticket.php:172 daily per-prefix sequencing cover the main path, but missing: migration backfill/NOT NULL/down(), model InvalidArgumentException/normalization, canonical 010 rejection, single-clock issuance (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:10), factory issued_at alignment, docs; Ticket::nextCode regex allows <3 digits.

scope.evidence: change.diff:1-262 touches only IssueTicket, UpdateQueue, Queue, Ticket, TicketFactory and the tickets migration, all task-related; no unrelated features.

security.evidence: app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:32 Gate authorization preserved and ValidationException raised, but app/Models/Queue.php:96 makes priority_prefix_map fillable and no model-level validation, allowing the map to bypass UpdateQueue auth/validation via mass assignment.

simplicity.evidence: Core prefix/day logic reuses Queue::prefixForPriority and Ticket::nextCode; excess is UpdateQueue duplicate uniqueness loops plus extra Queue query in Ticket::nextCode and factory.

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-262 lists no *Test.php additions or modifications; new behavior ships without Pest/PHPUnit coverage.

review.summary: Change implements default/custom prefixes and per-day per-prefix sequencing, but misses model-level validation/normalization, proper migration/backfill/NOT NULL/down, single-clock issuance, factory date alignment, canonical-key rejection, docs and tests, and wrongly makes the map fillable.
